description: Returns one category: its title, slug, parent, full path from the top-level category, whether it has subcategories and their ids and titles, how many events are open in it and its trading volume. Use it to walk down the category tree; pass a category id (or a child's id) to get_markets `categories` to list its events. Category ids come from get_categories or from an event's `category`.

currency_mode.description: Count open events (and children with open events) for "play_money" or "real_money". Omit for play money.

id.description: Category id, from get_categories or get_markets.

name: get_category_details
title: Get category details
